# October 2026 for September 2024 to February 2027, with January 2029
# January 2030 and September 2037), written as rules:

#   lessons of the Sixth Hour and Vespers, as the OCA lists them;
# - the Epistle after Pentecost by the week (the week after the nth Sunday
#   after Pentecost is week n+1), counted on to the 32nd week and, in a long

# - the Gospel by the weeks of Matthew until the Sunday after the
#   Exaltation (the 17th week reads the 15th of Luke), then by the weeks of
